project_type: Go rule engine + Strapi 5 CMS monorepo
build_system: Go modules for engine, npm for CMS. Engine requires CGO_ENABLED=1 for decision/ZEN package.
test_command: cd engine && CGO_ENABLED=1 go test ./... (engine) | cd cms && npm run build && npm run test (CMS)
verification_instructions: 1. Engine: CGO_ENABLED=1 go build ./... && go test ./... in engine directory. 2. CMS: npm run build && npm run test in cms directory.
environment_constraints: CGO_ENABLED=1 required for Go builds (ZEN decision engine). Working in worktree at /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/webhook-triggers on branch feat/webhook-triggers.
contribution_requirements: Secrets via secretRef only (never inline). Operator auth on all /admin/* endpoints. Rate limiting on public endpoints. Signature verification required in production.

key_patterns.config_store: PgStore implements Store interface with cache-aside pattern. Migrations in engine/migrations/. Objects have identity tables + immutable version tables + active_pointers.
key_patterns.admin_api: Admin struct in internal/httpapi/admin.go mounts routes on mux with OperatorGuard protection. Handlers use writeJSON/writeError, decodeJSON helpers. Status mapping via statusForAdmin.
key_patterns.flow_trigger: genericFlowHandler resolves active routes per-request, pins flow version via store.ActiveFlow, builds flow.Ctx from request, runs interpreter.Run.
key_patterns.secret_handling: SecretProvider interface (Resolve, Watch) in internal/connect/secret.go. envProvider resolves 'env:NAME' refs. Secrets never stored inline - always secretRef.
key_patterns.rate_limiting: rateLimitMiddleware wraps mux, newRateLimiter builds token bucket from RateLimitConfig in Deps.
key_patterns.cms_content_types: Content types in cms/src/api/<name>/content-types/<name>/schema.json. Components in cms/src/components/.
key_patterns.admin_client: AdminClient class in cms/src/plugins/rule-engine/server/src/services/admin-client.ts provides typed methods for engine admin API.

directory_structure.engine/: Go rule engine - internal/ has packages (config, httpapi, auth, connect, flow, decision, observ). migrations/ has SQL. cmd/engine has main.
directory_structure.engine/internal/config/: Configuration store - PgStore (Postgres), memStore (testing), types (FlowVersion, ConnectionDef), migrations
directory_structure.engine/internal/httpapi/: HTTP handlers - server.go (router), admin.go (control plane), ops.go (health), ratelimit.go
directory_structure.engine/internal/flow/: Flow interpreter - ctx.go (Ctx), interpreter.go, handlers.go, spec.go
directory_structure.cms/src/api/: Strapi content types - flow/, connection/, jdm/, environment/
directory_structure.cms/src/plugins/rule-engine/: Rule engine plugin - admin/ (custom fields), server/ (services, controllers)
